subject: Hosting-ready dining and hallway storage for Christmas
hook: Sideboards and hallway storage made to measure in Newcastle-under-Lyme
gbp:
Made-to-measure sideboards and hallway storage for homes in Newcastle-under-Lyme and across Staffordshire.

Hosting shows up the gaps in a home quickly: coats with nowhere to go, no surface near the dining table, glasses and linen buried in the wrong cupboards. We design and build furniture that fixes those gaps for good.

Sideboards: sized to your dining room, with a top at a comfortable serving height, shallow drawers for cutlery and napkins, and cupboards for platters and glassware.

Hallway storage benches: a seat for pulling boots on, shoe drawers underneath and space for coat hooks above, built to fit between the radiator and the door.

Finishes include oak-effect, charcoal, black woodgrain, matt white and painted looks, with antique gold or matt black handles and soft-close hardware as standard.

Every piece is designed with you at a free, no-obligation consultation, priced in an itemised quote, built in our own workshop and installed by our own team.

Book a consultation to start planning for the year ahead.
